results.rationale: Consistency: the dark background, sleeve and cupped hand remain substantially consistent, but the entire overhead faucet has disappeared, an unrequested major object removal. Instruction: the small rod formerly held above the palm is now absent, fully satisfying the requested removal. Knowledge: the bent stream has vanished rather than becoming a vertical downward stream; this entirely fails the supplied expected water-flow outcome. Quality: the edited image alone has a coherent hand and sleeve, natural lighting and continuous background; its softness does not obscure the subject and no clear artifact is visible.

Consistency: the printer body, buttons, rear blank sheet and white setting remain recognizable, but the output tray is extended into a large dark frame, the printer surface has acquired conspicuous rippled texture, and a new partial gray object appears at bottom right. Instruction: the formerly blank front sheet now bears dense printed lines and is positioned directly in front of the printer, matching the requested printed document placement. Quality: overall printer and paper geometry are coherent, but pervasive wormlike texture on the printer casing and excessively repetitive illegible print create noticeable visual artifacts.
